name: cmdr-demo-video
description: Cmdr's 90-second promo videos, built with Remotion from a script, TTS voice, CC music, and app footage

scripts.stems:demo: remotion render src/index.ts CmdrDemo out/demo-stem-voice.wav --codec=wav --props=props/stem-voice.json && remotion render src/index.ts CmdrDemo out/demo-stem-music.wav --codec=wav --props=props/stem-music.json && remotion render src/index.ts CmdrDemo out/demo-stem-mix.wav --codec=wav
scripts.stems:anywhere: remotion render src/index.ts CmdrAnywhere out/anywhere-stem-voice.wav --codec=wav --props=props/stem-voice.json && remotion render src/index.ts CmdrAnywhere out/anywhere-stem-music.wav --codec=wav --props=props/stem-music.json && remotion render src/index.ts CmdrAnywhere out/anywhere-stem-mix.wav --codec=wav
